No maintainer has commented, closed an issue or merged a pull request in the past year.
16 pull requests opened in the past year and none merged — contributors are offering fixes that nobody lands.

results.rationale: Released 3.3.2 on 2023-07-25, three years before verification. Superseded in practice by the global fetch built into Node 18+, but never deprecated and the repository is not archived, so the honest state is quiet rather than dead.
